Figure 10:Alive keys of every head in the final FPA model.Each cell gives the percentage of keys with a bias of at least−1-1over the queries from position 1024 on in 256 test windows, with layers and heads counted from 1.
Dots mark the 19 heads whose alive sets are not suffixes at more than 10% of the queries.
FPA, First Passage Attention.

Figure 15:Median alive span of every head in the final FPA model.Spans over the queries 1024 to 2047 of the 12 validation windows, with layers and heads counted from 1.
Triangles mark the 21 heads whose span grew or shrank by a factor of two or more since step 1500.
FPA, First Passage Attention.

Figure 18:Retention by token class in the final FPA model.Share of the keys of each class that are still alive 256 positions later, for pairs of key and query in one document, and in the last column for pairs across a document boundary.
Content heads lie above the line and the document heads of step 3250 below it, with layers and heads counted from 1.
By the final step layer 9, head 5 kept only 76% of the keys within a document and no longer counted as a document head.
FPA, First Passage Attention.

Figure 19:The bias of layer 1, head 1 on C++ code in the final FPA model.Weight factorebt​se^{b_{ts}}of every keyssfor every queryttat positions 1100 to 1163 of validation window 0, with factors below 0.02 left white.
A key is alive while its factor is at leaste−1e^{-1}.
Groups of keys stop being alive at once, nine at the end of a statement and three to six at newlines, dots and underscores.
FPA, First Passage Attention.

Figure 20:The bias of layer 1, head 10 on a news report in the final FPA model.Weight factorebt​se^{b_{ts}}at positions 1100 to 1163 of validation window 680, with factors below 0.02 left white.
Articles, prepositions, punctuation and newlines stop being alive at the next token, while content words such assaidandpagestay alive to the end of the stretch.
FPA, First Passage Attention.

Figure 21:The bias of layer 4, head 9 at a document boundary in the final FPA model.Weight factorebt​se^{b_{ts}}at positions 233 to 296 of validation window 680, with factors below 0.02 left white.
At the end-of-document token 36 of the 39 earlier keys of the stretch stop being alive, and at the start-of-document token the others do.
No key of the stretch before the boundary stays alive in the next document.
FPA, First Passage Attention.
